critique.evidence: The section is visually cohesive and polished: strong editorial headline, disciplined dark palette, clear cyan/amber/red semantic accents, consistent borders, and responsive card restructuring across all three viewports. However, the global header falls below demo-ready polish at tablet and mobile: labels are visibly truncated, the navigation depends on clipped horizontal content, “SWIPE →” competes with nearby items, and the mobile wordmark disappears, weakening identity. Several mono labels and supporting lines are also extremely small and low-contrast, while desktop has excessive unused vertical space around the hero.
critique.fix: Refine the responsive header with deliberate compact labels or an overflow/menu treatment, retain a recognizable mobile wordmark, and prevent partial navigation labels. Increase the size/contrast of microcopy and tighten desktop hero spacing while preserving the current hierarchy and restrained palette.
